name: Enhanced Testing Tools
description: Enhanced testing utilities with clear separation between moonlighting and service availability data
author: FacultyHub Team
features: Separate reset controls for service availability vs moonlighting
improvements_from_legacy: Separated 'Clear Requests' into two distinct buttons
Added preview of what will be deleted
Year and month filters for targeted cleanup
No ambiguity about which system is being reset
use_cases: Testing point allocation system multiple times
Resetting service availability for new draft rounds
Cleaning moonlighting signups between test cycles
Clearing generated schedules to re-run optimizer
Impersonating faculty to test their workflows
safety_warnings: These tools are destructive - use only in testing
Production use should be rare and deliberate
